R package, หนังสือ และ เครื่องมือต่าง ๆ ที่ พัฒนาขึ้น

## R packages

| Package | What it does |
|---|---|
| [**ricecooker**](https://github.com/kanthjs/ricecooker) | Analysis of agricultural field experiments — CRD, RCBD and split-plot designs, CV%, DMRT, data transformations, Type III SS, and ready-made plots |
| [**talatThaiR**](https://github.com/kanthjs/talatThaiR) | Fetch Thai agricultural price and production index data straight into R |
| [**kanth_lib**](https://github.com/kanthjs/kanth_lib) | My personal R library |

## Apps

| App | What it does |
|---|---|
| [**Rice Blast Forecast**](https://kanthjs.github.io/rice_blast_forcast_app/) | Rice blast disease forecasting tool |
| [**Rice Pest Warning**](https://kanthjs.github.io/rice_pest_warning_app/) | Rice pest warning based on historical survey data |
| [**RDstat**](https://kanthjs.github.io/RDstat/) | Statistical analysis in the browser — R runs on your own machine, so uploaded data never leaves your computer |
| [**RBTool**](https://kanthjs.github.io/RBTool/) | Plant breeding trial analysis in the browser — single-environment, multi-environment, and GxE / stability analyses (IRRI PBTools re-engineered with Shinylive) |
